entries.summary: Checked on the Mac: node, git, npm, ffmpeg, doppler, claude and manim (~/.venvs/manim, v0.22.0) all ok, BasicTeX present, git push --dry-run succeeds. Fixed .local/dispatch.env: DOPPLER_CONFIG was the secret name OPENROUTER_ADMIN; now config 'dev', whose OPENROUTER_ADMIN key is the funded OpenRouter account.
Re-checked on the Mac (Christens-Laptop) so the per-machine entry carries a machine name: check.mjs --tools reports node, git, npm, ffmpeg, doppler, claude and manim ok; git push --dry-run succeeds.
GitHub Pages was off (404). Enabled it with gh api POST for gh-pages, root. Pages status is built and https://codexoperator.github.io/math-viz/ answers HTTP 200.

OpenRouter lists no ElevenLabs model with audio output, so speech uses openai/gpt-audio-mini (voice sage) via streamed chat/completions (pcm16, the only shape OpenRouter accepts for audio), with a read-verbatim instruction; music uses google/lyria-3-clip-preview. Scratch test made a valid 11.5 s speech clip (transcript matched word for word) and a 15.3 s music clip; temporary key deleted each run.
Checked on linux-box: check.mjs --tools reports node (v24.22.0), git, npm, ffmpeg, doppler, claude and manim (~/.venvs/manim) ok; git push --dry-run succeeds.

ElevenLabs is listed (eleven-v4, v3, multilingual-v2 and others; all on POST /audio/speech with 21 named voices). Fixed generate-audio.mjs so the speech endpoint gets the bare text rather than the 'read this aloud' chat prompt, which a real TTS model would have spoken. Scratch test with elevenlabs/eleven-v4, voice george made two valid mono mp3 clips (8.8 s and 9.6 s, a natural pace for the text, including 'z equals minus one plus i root three'); temporary key deleted. audio-config.json now uses eleven-v4/george. No narration files exist yet, so nothing was regenerated. The agent could not listen to the clips; it checked durations and levels only.

npm test passes (801/801). smoke.mjs could not start: Playwright is not installed globally on linux-box (MODULE_NOT_FOUND for playwright under the node prefix), so no screenshots were taken or reviewed.
entries.needs_from_student: On linux-box run `npm install -g playwright && npx playwright install chromium` (or ask the agent to do it on the next interactive run), then the next tick retries L6. Alternatively run L6 on the Mac (Christens-Laptop), which is closer to what the task describes.
